Milwaukee finished the regular season 103-59, the best record in baseball, scoring 832 runs and allowing 618, and the official schedule lists Jacob Misiorowski as their probable starter. Tampa Bay went 98-64 with 736 scored and 650 allowed and had no probable pitcher posted when the schedule was captured. A single baseball game is a thin thing to be certain about, so medium confidence, but the home side with the deeper run differential and the named starter is the moneyline selection at -167.
